frozen.question: What battery-life problems or benefits do iPhone 8 owners report?

chunks.text: Battery life is terrible constant problems with the phone. Battery life is terrible constant problems with the phone
battery life problem. Battery life is terrible, just 3-4 hours.

Renewed but Battery Life is in jeopardy. Although these (both that I ordered) were listed as renewed/new the battery life is less than 80% (under the status report in settings) and one is stating needs service. I expect that as renewed there'd be some degradation but not "needs service"
The battery life was low. Battery life was low. I had to buy a new battery
Battery life. Battery needed to be replace- wouldn't hold a charge. That’s my only complaint

The battery life is low🤦🏾♂️. The phone is really nice i was scared at first and thinking it wasn’t going to be good but it turnt out great. This is my first day using it but so far there’s no problem except that the phone battery life is 79% everything is good.
battery life and condition. Great battery life and great condition. No visible scratches and dents.

Battery life is much better than represented by reviews.. Battery life is much better than represented by reviews. Plenty of charge for a day unless you spend most of your time on FaceTime or watching Netflix.
Battery life. Battery life is terrible. I've had it for 28 days and already have to replace it.
Apple device's battery life will always be shit, but what can we do.. Apple battery life on many devices will decrease in longevity for as long as you own the device. The phone works perfectly.

sentences.text: One iPhone 8 owner described the battery life as terrible with constant problems with the phone.
Another reviewer reported a battery life problem, saying it was terrible at just 3-4 hours.
A reviewer of renewed units said the battery life was under 80% per the settings status report and that one unit stated it needs service.
One owner said the battery life was low and that they had to buy a new battery.
Another reviewer said the battery needed to be replaced because it wouldn't hold a charge, calling that their only complaint.
In contrast, one reviewer said the battery life was much better than represented by reviews, with plenty of charge for a day unless most of the time is spent on FaceTime or watching Netflix.

frozen.draft_answer:
One iPhone 8 owner described the battery life as terrible with constant problems with the phone. [112d9256860e_0]
Another reviewer reported a battery life problem, saying it was terrible at just 3-4 hours. [63dce0a91d39_0]
A reviewer of renewed units said the battery life was under 80% per the settings status report and that one unit stated it needs service. [f361cc48d49f_0]
One owner said the battery life was low and that they had to buy a new battery. [319f0d462701_0]
Another reviewer said the battery needed to be replaced because it wouldn't hold a charge, calling that their only complaint. [680d31d2c44b_0]
In contrast, one reviewer said the battery life was much better than represented by reviews, with plenty of charge for a day unless most of the time is spent on FaceTime or watching Netflix. [fe86c95c4ae5_0]
